about: Sennen Surfing Centre is a surf school and shop right on the sand at Sennen Cove, at the far western tip of Cornwall. It runs an award-winning O'Neill Academy with fully qualified coaches. It offers group and private lessons, plus discounts for larger groups, families, schools, colleges and community projects. The shop also sells clothing and surf hardware.
offers: Group bookings for families, schools, colleges and community projects
where: Beach cabin on Sennen Beach, Sennen Cove
goodToKnow: Book standard and private lessons online, or phone for advice
Terms and conditions and FAQs are on the website
Coaches are described as fully qualified
season: Open daily until October in summer 2026
